overview: The Rajasthan Agro Processing Startup Scheme is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and innovation in the agro-processing sector within Rajasthan. It supports startups engaged in value addition, processing, and preservation of agricultural produce through financial and non-financial assistance. The scheme seeks to enhance rural employment, reduce post-harvest losses, and strengthen the agro-value chain by encouraging technology-driven solutions. It aligns with the state's vision to position Rajasthan as a hub for agro-processing startups.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the agro-processing sector
Reduce post-harvest losses through value addition and processing
Generate employment opportunities in rural areas
Encourage adoption of modern technology in agro-processing
Strengthen linkages between farmers, processors, and markets
Support sustainable and scalable agro-processing business models
Enhance income and livelihoods of farming communities
Position Rajasthan as a leading destination for agro-processing startups
eligibility: Startups registered in Rajasthan engaged in agro-processing activities such as grading, sorting, packaging, preservation, or value addition of agricultural produce. The entity must be recognized by DPIIT or registered under the Startup India initiative. Preference is given to ventures led by women, SC/ST, or differently abled entrepreneurs. The startup should have a viable business model with potential for scalability and job creation.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants or seed funding, mentorship and incubation support, access to testing and certification facilities, assistance in market linkage and branding, facilitation of regulatory approvals, and networking opportunities with investors and industry experts. Additional benefits include priority in government procurement, access to shared infrastructure, and technical guidance on food safety standards.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance up to INR 25 lakhs per eligible startup as a grant for capital expenditure, working capital, or technology acquisition. The support is disbursed in tranches based on milestone achievement and utilization verification. There is no equity dilution or repayment obligation under this grant-based mechanism.
application_process: 1. Visit the official Rajasthan State Scheme Dashboard or Jan Soochna Portal. 2. Navigate to the 'Rajasthan Agro Processing Startup Scheme' under the Agriculture or Industries department. 3. Click on 'Apply Now' and register using Jan Aadhaar or SSO ID. 4. Fill in the application form with details of the startup, business model, and projected impact. 5. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, DPIIT recognition, PAN, and project report. 6. Submit the application and await scrutiny by the nodal agency. 7. Shortlisted applicants may be called for presentation or interview. 8. Upon approval, the grant is disbursed in phases as per milestones.
required_documents: Bank account details of the startup
Details of promoters and their qualifications
Quotations for equipment or technology to be procured
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan
caveats: Grant is subject to submission of utilization certificates and audit reports
Funds must be utilized only for approved agro-processing activities
Startup must maintain operations in Rajasthan for at least 3 years post-funding
Misrepresentation of facts may lead to recovery of grant with interest
Beneficiaries cannot avail similar benefits from other state or central schemes for the same purpose
